name: self-host-apps:import-awesome-selfhosted
purpose: Parse the live Awesome Selfhosted Markdown list into normalized version127 self-host app batch records.

name: self-host-apps:import-selfhst
purpose: Import new selfh.st software directory candidates as draft batch records after repository, slug, website, and name dedupe against the current database.

name: self-host-apps:import-awesome
purpose: Discover app candidates from Awesome-style JSON or Markdown sources.

name: self-host-apps:import-github-topic
purpose: Discover app candidates from GitHub repository topics.

name: self-host-apps:reset-categories
purpose: Reset category rows and app category links to the controlled Version127 self-host app taxonomy.

name: self-host-apps:draft-all
purpose: Mark every self-host app as draft before publishing only reviewed/enriched batches.

name: self-host-apps:select-enrichment-batch
purpose: Write a deterministic enrichment queue from local app rows with missing data.

name: self-host-apps:enrich-github-batch
purpose: Enrich and publish GitHub-backed rows with verified repository, release, Docker, maintainer, resource, and provenance fields.

name: self-host-apps:refresh-github
purpose: Refresh changing GitHub facts for existing rows: stars, latest release, last commit, license fill-ins, maintenance status, and checked timestamp. Scheduled by .github/workflows/self-host-apps-refresh-github.yml.

name: self-host-apps:validate
purpose: Validate one normalized self-host app record before upsert.

name: self-host-apps:upsert
purpose: Upsert one normalized self-host app record and category links.

name: self-host-apps:upsert-batch
purpose: Upsert a reviewed batch as draft or published rows while preserving category links and source metadata.

name: self-host-apps:cache-icons
purpose: Cache favicon-style app icons locally and update batch icon_url values.

name: self-host-apps:audit-summaries
purpose: Audit database or file records for weak summaries.

name: self-host-apps:audit-links
purpose: Audit stored app links with HTTP HEAD/GET checks.

name: self-host-apps:qa-report
purpose: Rank published app rows by quality risk across summaries, licenses, database facts, Docker proof, docs fallbacks, releases, and icon file health.

name: self-host-apps:qa-gate
purpose: Report hard publish blockers separately from soft review warnings, including broken summaries, missing licenses, bad icons, database contradictions, and risky Docker proof.

name: self-host-apps:icon-integrity
purpose: Audit published app icons for remote URLs, missing files, tiny files, and local files whose bytes do not match their .png extension. Use --fix --cache-remote --fix-local after review.

name: self-host-apps:apply-qa-overrides
purpose: Apply reviewed field-level QA fixes and source provenance for selected self-host app rows without re-upserting unrelated data.

name: self-host-apps:sanitize-risky-facts
purpose: Reset risky inferred database and Docker facts to unknown/null before publication. Use this before the stricter QA gate when a broad import or enrichment pass inferred facts from weak source text.

name: self-host-apps:sync-local-to-prod
purpose: Mirror the verified local self-host app tables into production: apps, category taxonomy, category joins, raw sources, and field provenance. Production rows missing locally are drafted, not deleted.
